title: A Quote and a Table
contentHTML:
A calm reading surface gives the words enough room to establish their own rhythm without adding another layer of interface.

Host: What changed when the page got quieter?

Guest: People stayed with the words longer. The one thing we kept was the rhythm.

A calm reading surface gives the words enough room to establish their own rhythm without adding another layer of interface.
